cases.prompt: Reduce the defensive language in this Discussion paragraph, but keep the real limitations.
cases.input: Although these findings may potentially seem somewhat preliminary, it is important to note that this study is not without limitations. Some might argue that the observed association could possibly reflect residual confounding, and it should be acknowledged that the results may perhaps be less robust than they first appear. Because the data were collected retrospectively, we cannot rule out recall bias in the exposure measure. The sample was relatively small (n = 418), and it is worth noting that further research is needed before these findings can be generalized. Nevertheless, the association between sleep duration and self-rated health (β = −0.34, 95% CI −0.51 to −0.17; p < 0.001) may potentially suggest a possible dose-response pattern.

cases.input: It should be noted that the study was a retrospective cohort, so we cannot rule out reverse causation or residual confounding. The estimate was imprecise (hazard ratio 1.18, 95% CI 0.94–1.49), and the confidence interval includes the null. All participants gave written informed consent, and the protocol was approved by the local ethics committee (approval no. 2024-117). The authors declare no competing interests.
